mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2% indicates a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the year-over-year GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeds 2% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.05%, it signals ultra-loose monetary policy, reducing risk-free rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.05% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeds 2% AND the year-over-year employment growth rate (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it indicates a robust economy with strong labor conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 2% AND PAYEMS YoY growth > 0.5%
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both the year-over-year GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeds 2% AND the year-over-year employment growth rate (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals a high-unemployment regime where the Federal Reserve maintains low interest rates and provides stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year industrial production growth rate (INDPRO) above 1% indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the year-over-year industrial production growth rate (INDPRO) exceeds 1% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.05% AND the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it indicates a high-risk environment of low rates and high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.05% AND the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals a strengthening housing market and broader economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).
